items.title: Percy Gabriel Interview, 1987-07-10
items.q: I recorded with Mercury. And, oh, I can, with Jimmy Witherspoon singing. Charles Waterford singing.

ctx.x: I recorded with Mercury. And, oh, I can, with Jimmy Witherspoon singing. Charles Waterford singing. We did a lot of recording in St. Louis. We did some recording in California. Mm-hmm. Now, I don't keep them. Only a couple of the numbers. One I can remember because I named the number and it was my idea. It was a number we called Bucktown Boogie. I thought about this little place we used to come. My daddy used to play out in Bucktown. Mm-hmm. And, I was featured solo on it. I had one record and I loaned it to a…
